children: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers rescheduled its earnings release and conference call to Nov. 18, giving the company more time to complete financial statements and related disclosures.

The restaurant chain said it completed significant refranchising transactions and refinanced its existing debt during the third quarter. The complexity of the accounting and valuation analyses associated with these transactions caused the company to move its meeting date from Nov. 4.
Reb Robin also said the delay is unrelated to any significant changes in financial condition or results of operations.
The company also released some preliminary and unaudited results, stating that the total change in comparable restaurant revenue for the 12 weeks ended Oct. 4 was 3.9%, compared with the prior year.
